summary: A modular synth framework forked from Modular-1: build patches from modules in a browser editor, group them into reusable nested assemblies, and send them to the FM-1 to play.
features: Browser patch editor with emulator, library and share links
Assemblies nest without limit; 71 factory assemblies incl. synth-inspired instruments
One patch at a time; 64 slots with 29 factory patches
Polyphony via a Voicing module; 3 or 4 voices typical on the FM-1
Steps tracks with drum steps, piano roll, p-locks and songs
First start overwrites Felucca projects, samples and presets

headings: we stand on the shoulders of giants!!
the software that starts the fm-1, and m-vave official open
sequencer, clock divider, s&h, quantizer, pulse
pan, crossfade, vowel, phaser, digitizer, noise colour
share a patch as a link
